Swimmer plots

Source: vignettes/swimmer-plots.Rmd
swimmer-plots.Rmd

A swimmer plot gives every patient a lane: how long they were on treatment or on study, when they responded, when they progressed and who is still going. It is the standard picture of response in single arm and early phase trials, where the course of each patient matters as much as the summary. ggswimmer() draws one with each lane’s record under the pointer.

library(ggextreme)

A first swimmer plot

The survival package ships myeloid, a simulated data set based on a trial in acute myeloid leukemia, with the times of complete response, stem cell transplant, relapse and death. The first 30 patients make a readable plot. The events go in a data frame of their own, one row per event, with the patient’s id, the time and what happened:

aml <- subset(survival::myeloid, id <= 30)
aml$arm <- paste("Arm", aml$trt)
month <- 30.44
events <- rbind(
  data.frame(id = aml$id, time = aml$crtime / month, event = "Complete response"),
  data.frame(id = aml$id, time = aml$txtime / month, event = "Transplant"),
  data.frame(id = aml$id, time = aml$rltime / month, event = "Relapse"),
  data.frame(id = aml$id, time = ifelse(aml$death == 1, aml$futime / month, NA),
             event = "Death")
)
events <- events[!is.na(events$time), ]

ggswimmer(aml, id, futime / month, events = events, group = arm,
          ongoing = death == 0, hover = c("sex", "flt3"),
          ongoing_label = "Alive at last follow-up",
          xlab = "Months since randomization",
          title = "Acute myeloid leukemia, 30 patients")

Hover over a lane to read the patient’s arm, the columns named in hover, the first time of each event and whether they are still being followed; the other lanes fade. Click it for the patient’s events in order, beside their full record. The buttons under the plot reorder the lanes, longest first, by arm, by best response or in the order of the data, and the lanes slide into place.

Events

end and ongoing take expressions of the columns of data, as above. Events are drawn by their wording, whatever the case:

wording mark
complete, CR star
partial, PR, response, remission triangle
progression, PD, relapse, recurrence diamond
death, died cross
anything else a circle or square in its own color

Options

argument effect
start where each bar starts; zero by default
group the column that colors the bars, such as the arm
ongoing, ongoing_label who gets an arrow, and what it means
sort the order of a static copy: "duration", "group", "response" or "data"
palette colors for the groups
hover columns for each lane’s hover card

On a dark page the plot takes a dark palette of its own, and graph_save(s, "swimmer.png", theme = "dark") writes a dark static copy.
